_about: Single source of truth for the broker's pricing math. economics.py reads this file and enforces profit_rule; run `python3 economics.py --check` before changing any live price. Wholesale costs are public list prices gathered 2026-10-29; replace them with contracted rates as soon as you have them.

profit_rule._note: Every plan, founder variant, annual price and top-up must clear floor_margin_worst_case with 100% of its credits spent (including bonus, founder kickback and referral payouts). Losses are allowed only inside a cac_tests entry with a budget cap and an end date.

wholesale._unit: USD per output. Video = one 5-second clip unless noted. Sources: fal.ai model pages via devtk.ai / ofox.ai / buildmvpfast.com (Sep-Oct 2026), Google Gemini API pricing via benchlm.ai (2026-09-11).

plans._note: credits = monthly allowance; bonus_credits = monthly bonus pack (higher tiers only). infra_usd = storage at full quota (R2 $0.015/GB) + compute/support; Elite includes a shared account manager. Rollover capped at 1x the allowance.

exclusive: Early access to new models (7 days ahead)
Early access to new models (14 days ahead)

annual._note: Billed yearly; same credits per month. Studio/Elite get smaller or no discounts because 10% off broke the profit rule (economics.py --check).

founders._note: Founding Member program for the first 10,000 subscribers. They pay a premium monthly price and get a monthly kickback in credits. Kickbacks are platform credits only: never cash, never transferable, never tied to company revenue or profit. That keeps it a loyalty program and not a security; get a lawyer to confirm before launch.
founders.price_lock: Founder price is locked for life while the subscription stays active; lapses on cancel.
perks: Vote on which models we add

referrals._note: Paid in credits to the referrer for 12 months. Counted against the referred user's margin in the profit check.

topups._note: One-time packs. No expiry while subscribed. Elite gets 10% off.

cac_tests._note: The only place a loss is allowed. Each test needs a budget cap, an end date and a kill rule. economics.py totals the exposure.

trial_7day_starter.what: 7-day Starter trial for $1, card required, 500 credits

creator_seeding.what: 50 hand-picked creators get Pro free for 2 months in exchange for content rights

higgsfield_reference._source: Live pricing config returned by Higgsfield's own MCP server (show_plans_and_credits), pulled 2026-10-29.

assumptions._note: Guesses until you have real usage data. Change them and re-run economics.py.

usage_mix._note: Share of credits spent on each output. Must sum to 1.

assumptions._ladder_note: Blended ARPU for the revenue ladder: plan mix 50% Starter / 30% Pro / 15% Studio / 5% Elite plus ~15% top-up uplift, before founder premiums.
